news.title: Troy Jackson doesn’t regret telling opponent Susan Collins to ‘shut up’
news.summary: Democrat Troy Jackson said on Sunday he does not regret telling his opponent Sen. Susan Collins (R-Maine) to “shut up” during a candidate debate that was interrupted by an anti-data center protester.
